sentences.text:
Lakhwinder Singh And Another vs State Of Punjab And Others
on 13 September, 2024
Mohit
2024.09.17 09:54
SuRa Phc Tss
In The High Court Of Punjab And Haryana

At Chandigarh
252
Crm-M-36109-2024
Date of Decision: 13.09.2024

Lakhwinder Singh And Another
...Petitioners
Versus
State Of Punjab And Others
...Respondents

Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Manisha Batra
Present:- Mr. Aditya Dassaur, Advocate for the petitioners.
Mr. Satjot Singh, Aag, Punjab.
Mr. Harmanjeet Singh Dhaliwal, Advocate for
Mr. Neeraj Singh Mahal, Advocate for respondent Nos.2 and 3.
36 2 2s 24s 2k
Manisha Batra, J. (Oral)
1.

The present petition has been filed under Section 482 of Code of Criminal Procedure for quashing of FIR No.13 dated 04.02.2024 registered under Sections 406, 420, 467 and 120-B of IPC at Police Station Division No.7, Jalandhar (Annexure P-8) and all the subsequent proceedings arising therefrom, on the basis of compromise deed dated 18.07.2024 and affidavits dated 18.07.2024 (Annexures P-9 and P-10 respectively).
2.

This Court vide order dated 06.08.2024 had directed the parties to appear before the trial Court to get their statements recorded and the learned Magistrate was directed to send its report qua the genuineness of the compromise.

3. Pursuant to the aforesaid order, parties have appeared before the Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Jalandhar and got their statements recorded.

On the basis of the statements so recorded, learned Judge has submitted report dated 23.08.2024 to the effect that the compromise has been effected between the parties voluntarily and without any coercion or undue influence.

sentences.text: Learned State counsel as well as counsel for respondent Nos.2 and 3 have not disputed the factum of compromise between the parties.
5. In view of the above, no useful purpose would be served to continue with the proceedings before the trial Court in the instant FIR.

6. Following the principles laid down by the Full Bench judgment of this Court in Kulwinder Singh and others Versus State of Punjab and another 2007 (3) RCR (Criminal) 1052 and approved by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Gian Singh Versus State of Punjab and others (2012) 10 SCC 303, this petition is allowed and FIR No.13 dated 04.02.2024 registered under Sections 406, 420, 467 and 120-B of IPC at Police Station Division No.7, Jalandhar (Annexure P-8)and all subsequent proceedings arising therefrom on the basis of compromise deed dated 18.07.2024 and affidavits dated 18.07.2024 are quashed qua the petitioners.
7. Since the passport of the petitioner No.2-Ravinder Kaur is stated to have been confiscated and lying in the custody of the Investigating Officer of the case, therefore, direction is given to the Investigating Officer to release the same, if it is not required in any other matter.
